summary: A 152-level binary hypertree. A message-derived index selects one leaf per two-leaf tree. The bottom tree authenticates a 16-byte preimage; each of 151 upper trees uses 46 base-8 WOTS chains to sign the previous root. Verification compares the final root with the 16-byte public key. Based on Holindauer’s certified PR #12.

facts.label: Signature layout
facts.value: 32 B randomizer + 32 B bottom proof + 151 × 752 B upper proofs = 113,616 B

facts.label: Path selection
facts.value: A 152-bit message-derived index chooses the left or right leaf at each level

facts.label: WOTS encoding
facts.value: 128-bit root → 43 base-8 digits + 3 checksum digits; 46 chains of up to 7 steps

facts.label: Upper proof
facts.value: 46 × 16 B WOTS values + one 16 B Merkle sibling

facts.label: Expansion
facts.value: Copies the signature into the witness; W = S = 113,616 B

facts.label: Source
facts.value: Port of Holindauer’s certified PR #12 to the current beta interface
